2608.31007.title: Augmenting Interviewer Judgments of Patient Experience with Automatic Language Analysis
2608.31007.paper_summary: Understanding how psychiatric patients subjectively experienced a clinical conversation is important for feedback and alliance-related process monitoring. While interviewers form post-session judgments about patient experience, these judgments do not always match patients' self-reports. Automatic approaches for predicting perceived interaction quality from conversation have been proposed, but it remains unclear whether such approaches can complement human judgment rather than simply replicate it. To address this gap, we evaluate a clinician-support framework in which post-session interviewer ratings are combined with automatic language-based predictions to estimate patient-reported interaction quality in free clinical interviews. We assess this integration across multiple standard model types, including Ridge, SVR, MLP, GRU, and BiLSTM, all trained on sentence embeddings extracted from dyadic transcripts of 107 free conversations between psychiatric patients and interviewers. Our results show that combining interviewer judgments with model predictions through simple averaging yields the strongest overall performance. The interviewer-only baseline reached a Pearson correlation of 0.365. Among fully automatic models, Ridge achieved the strongest Pearson correlation (r = 0.286), while BiLSTM achieved r = 0.270. The strongest result was obtained by BiLSTM interviewer integration (r = 0.403). Our findings suggest that automatic language analysis and interviewer judgment capture complementary aspects of patient experience and that their combination provides a more accurate approximation of the patient's own report than either source alone.
2608.31007.paper_summary_zh: 了解精神病患者主觀經歷臨床對話的方式對於反饋和聯盟相關的過程監控至關重要。<lb/>雖然訪談者會對患者的經歷形成會後評價，但這些評價並不總是與患者的自我報告相符。<lb/>已經提出了從對話中預測感知互動質量的自動化方法，但尚不清楚這些方法是否能夠補充人類判斷，而不僅僅是複製它。<lb/>為了解決這一空白，我們評估了一個臨床支持框架，在這個框架中，會後訪談者評分與自動語言基於預測相結合，以估算患者在自由臨床訪談中報告的互動質量。<lb/>我們在多種標準模型類型中評估了這一整合，包括 Ridge、SVR、MLP、GRU 和 BiLSTM，所有模型均基於從 107 次精神病患者與訪談者之間的自由對話中提取的句子嵌入進行訓練。<lb/>我們的結果顯示，通過簡單平均將訪談者的判斷與模型預測相結合，產生了最強的整體表現。<lb/>僅訪談者的基線達到了 0.365 的 Pearson 相關性。<lb/>在完全自動化模型中，Ridge 達到了最強的 Pearson 相關性 (r = 0.286)，而 BiLSTM 則達到了 r = 0.270。<lb/>最強的結果是通過 BiLSTM 訪談者整合獲得的 (r = 0.403)。<lb/>我們的研究結果表明，自動語言分析和訪談者判斷捕捉了患者經歷的互補方面，並且它們的結合提供了比單一來源更準確的患者自我報告的近似值。
